definitions.explanation: Something or someone else; things or people besides the one(s) mentioned. Often refers to other places, things, or matters.

examples.japanese: ⟦その{他|た}→その他：25037_sonota⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}います→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: The other expenses will be paid later.
examples.notes: 他に = besides this, in addition

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{他|た}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ない→見る：00283_miru⟧{美|うつく}しさだ。
examples.english: The scenery of this town has a beauty found nowhere else.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{他|た}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This problem affects other things as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{他|た}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦{話|はな}しましょう→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: Let's talk about the rest tomorrow.
examples.notes: その他 = the rest, and others

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{他|た}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{追随|ついずい}→追随：31488_tsuizui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}さない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧ほど⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: His skill is so advanced that no one else can match it.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
- In everyday speech this kanji is read ほか, as in ⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧? and ⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (see the ほか entry). Standing alone, the reading た is formal and written; in compounds such as ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧ it is everyday.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦その{他|た}→その他：25037_sonota⟧: and others, etc. (also read ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ほか)
- {他|た}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ない→見る：00283_miru⟧: unparalleled, found nowhere else
- {他|た}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{追随|ついずい}→追随：31488_tsuizui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}さない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: second to none
- In compounds: ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧ (other people), ⟦{他社|たしゃ}→他社：17803_tasha⟧ (another company), {自他|じた} (oneself and others)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: 'different, separate' rather than 'additional other'
